findings.title: Handoff and manifest declare an incorrect self-hash for HANDOFF_CHECK.json
findings.evidence: The actual active HANDOFF_CHECK.json SHA-256 is 6ee0dc247fe2830101070f4f70e45472052af04b54db02d69a4da0767e772c14. Both its own active_artifact_sha256_excluding_manifest entry and BATCH_MANIFEST.active_artifact_sha256 record 0c6eddd3fc77dabdc385271b3f639d20667f8294ad40ced137f2aceb6f8a3722 instead. The internal handoff hash therefore does not attest the submitted file.
findings.retest_action: Remove HANDOFF_CHECK.json's self-hash entry from its own hash list; regenerate the handoff; then update the manifest's hash for HANDOFF_CHECK.json to the regenerated file's actual hash. Recompute and verify all remaining hashes. A manifest hash must not be embedded into the handoff when the handoff is defined to exclude it.
